name: Sleet Storm
summary: Fills a Cylinder with sleet that obscures sight, knocks creatures Prone, and breaks Concentration.

stats.effect:
Until the spell ends, sleet falls in a 40-foot-tall, 20-foot-radius {ref:glossary/cylinder} centered on a point you choose within range. The area is {ref:glossary/heavily-obscured}, and exposed flames in the area are doused.

Ground in the Cylinder is {ref:glossary/difficult-terrain}. When a creature enters the Cylinder for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the {ref:condition/prone} condition and lose {ref:glossary/concentration}.
